correctness_confidence.basis: The reported day/week totals and exact decimal rate sums are internally consistent. A fresh read-only Tempo RPC check corroborated the cited successful transfer, historical decimals, 0-to-2000000 balance change and single-transaction block. Most Olas/CDP source rows were unavailable to this review.

rigor.basis: The manuscript separates frames, evidence predicates, rates, ownership, delivery and acceptance; it avoids causal price and market-demand inference. The 20-order selection inherits a truncated first-300 frame and the weekly extension is exploratory.

novelty.basis: The fixed-order source-layer comparison and recurrent no-marker cluster are useful bounded empirical candidates. Distinguishing payment from accepted economic output is already established in the cited literature, as the manuscript acknowledges.

significance.basis: A useful descriptive measurement case study for a developing ecosystem, with limited generalizability and no demonstrated autonomous demand, profitability or causal adoption effect. It is not field-changing evidence.

reproducibility.basis: The exact public PDF and source guide are available, and one chain case can be independently checked. The full retained catalogue responses, Olas rows, order evidence tables and executable reconstruction package are not supplied; main cluster/composition findings cannot yet be reproduced.

summary: A careful, substantively useful Working-paper candidate rather than an acceptance-ready empirical article. This is an exact-PDF review in the existing shared Codex chat, not a fresh blinded or independent human review. The earlier ordinary quality appraisal was 6.5/10; the distinct AIRR scientific-importance comparison score is 3.5/10 (four displayed stars), not a probability. Core arithmetic and the single Tempo payment are corroborated, while the broader Olas/CDP results remain author-reported without the computational archive. Public author deposit supersedes the frozen PDF preparation-time unpublished notice. Publish only with Working-paper status and preserved objections; request major revision before admission.
strengths: Pages 2-5 define noninterchangeable units and separate known, unknown, unperformed and inaccessible checks.
Pages 7-9: 622+667+5=1294; 6588+4675+63=11326; 6588+2085=8673; 4675-2085=2590=370x7. Decimal rate sums agree. These are arithmetic checks, not reconstruction of raw rows.

Page 13: independent read-only RPC retrieval confirms transaction 0xb5b6d20bfda9556201143722c6bcbe96f22078d554ad3351dad811972e18768d succeeded at block 46391423 on chain 4217, with six token decimals, recipient balance 0 before and 2000000 after, and one transaction in the block. This corroborates two tokens, not USD parity or autonomy.
The manuscript explicitly avoids treating 104 recurrent addresses as retained independent customers and avoids interpreting tiny-rate clusters as proof of fraud.
The author release at github.com/Bemosha/holder-agent-payments-research/releases/tag/v2.0-working-paper provides the byte-identical PDF and a public source guide.
weaknesses: The reading release is explicitly not the full computational reproduction package. Sampling queries, response hashes, retained rows and executable calculations underlying the principal empirical findings are not accessible as a complete auditable bundle.

The 20-order audit was selected from a first-300 pilot frame and is not an unbiased sample of the expanded day or week. Source-layer counts are descriptive predicates, not attrition or market completion rates.

Funding and relevant commercial counterparty relationships remain unconfirmed in the author declarations. The Holder.io affiliation and affiliate-revenue interest are disclosed but do not complete these declarations.

The frozen PDF says it was not submitted/published; the subsequent public author release explains and supersedes that preparation-time notice. A corrected archival edition should make the chronology self-contained.
potential_errors: Without the retained per-order rows, the repeated 370-request cluster and address recurrence predicates cannot be checked for deduplication, filter, time-boundary or attribution errors. This is an unresolved verification risk, not a detected false numerical claim.

Historical Diamond revision and complete bytecode-to-source equivalence were not independently verified in this review. Do not treat the checked transfer as certification of the entire implementation.
strong_novelty_candidates: Incremental information resolved across receipt, indexer and gateway layers while retaining the same twenty Olas order identifiers.
A repeated 370-request no-marker cluster across the seven-day queried frame, conditional on reproducible source rows.
unresolved_material_objections: The principal Olas clustering and catalogue-composition claims cannot be independently reconstructed from the supplied public reading package. Before acceptance, provide a rights-cleared reconstruction bundle containing query/filter/block specifications, hashes, minimally sufficient retained or derived rows, per-order linkage evidence and executable calculations; document unavailable inputs explicitly.
